<thought>From the 13C NMR data, peaks in the aromatic region (≈110–160 ppm) are: 143.10, 139.03, 135.88, 129.50 (twice), 129.01 (twice), 128.90 (twice), 128.50 (twice), and 127.20. Counting each carbon represented by these peaks (duplicates indicate two carbons each) gives 1 + 1 + 1 + 2 + 2 + 2 + 2 + 1 = 12 aromatic carbons.</thought>
<final_answer>12</final_answer>
